source: steward strategy ruling at /features-deliver EPIC-8 pre-run (job-1)
delivery_model: Per-card, one council-runner per card, sequential — never two runners at once against the same board. EV-18 runs the full /council loop in its own container. After EV-18 merges Done with gates green on the merged SHA, product-owner ratifies EV-19 Backlog -> Ready; EV-19 then runs as the second and final runner and records the real-host observation.

promotion_gate.precondition: EV-18 is merged Done with gates green on the merged SHA and EV-18's Acceptance met (the delivered placeholder pass-through exists to be observed), and a real-host observation is producible in the unattended container (a live pi 0.87.1 interactive host plus the observation/CDP path the run already uses). A promotion that cannot satisfy the second precondition is not a promotion — it is the fallback trigger.

rationale: EV-18 -> EV-19 is a hard dependency: EV-19 observes EV-18's delivered behaviour and cannot precede it. EV-19 sits in Backlog, so council.md step 1 refuses it until promoted. Per-card rather than batched because EV-19 is an observational card whose subject is EV-18's delivered behaviour, not an adjacent non-overlapping code change.
ending_condition: Run closes Done when EV-18 and EV-19 are both merged Done with gates SUCCESS on the merged SHA and EPIC-8 Acceptance holds: bunx tsc --noEmit exit 0, bun test green, PI-SPEC 7.2/8 synced, and EV-19's real-host observation recorded per its Acceptance (a)-(d) with the anticipated negative named as the residual. The epic is then set Done with a closure block recording the delivered children and the gates-at-closure.
fallback_ending: If product-owner declines the EV-19 promotion, or the real-host observation is not producible in the unattended container, or EV-19 exhausts its <=3 verify->fix cycles red, the run closes after EV-18 only: EPIC-8 left un-Done, EV-19 returned to Backlog (not retired, not re-sliced, not silently dropped) and named as an explicit residual, and the epic goal's EV-19 clause announced unmet. EV-18's merge and the residual are recorded in the Phase-3 run ledger. A step-13 follow-up card is filed only if EV-19's blocker is genuine new work.
constraints: One runner per card; never two runners in flight at once.
Promotion Backlog -> Ready is product-owner's judgment, not steward's; steward only sequences and gates it.
The greyed in-box render is accepted as a permanent out-of-portfolio residual — the extension-side obligation ends at forwarding the documented placeholder argument; the render is upstream (pi host).
No card retired, no child re-sliced.
Phase-1 rulings are binding: surface copy card-settled, second ui.input arg named placeholder, no new error/empty copy, uncertainty display n/a, gate verdict information-only.
The --admin merge bypass and direct-record push to main are authorized for this run only.
